notes: ‘*’ Adjusted Estimated Mid-year Population of Children (Below 18 Years) for newly created States Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, as
estimated population for these States were not available.

Rate of Cognizable Crimes = (Total Cases reported under Child Trafficking/ Population of Children) x 1,00,000
‘#’ Child Trafficking refers to Cases of Section 370/370A of IPC, Importation of Girls from Foreign Country(Section 366-B IPC), Procuration of
Minor Girls (Section 366-A IPC), Buying of Minor Girls for Prostitution and Cases under the Immoral Traffic (P) Act, 1956,
I - Incidence refer to Cases reported. V –refer to number of victims in reported cases
